faq.q: What is the cost of web development in Adelaide?
faq.a: Pricing starts from $400 for Astro landing pages and $600 for Next.js websites. Custom web applications start from $1500.
Astro landing pages take 7–14 days. Full Next.js websites take 2–4 weeks, and complex custom systems take 4–12 weeks.

faq.q: Do you develop Telegram bots and Mini Apps?
faq.a: Yes, we build intelligent bots for business automation. Prices start from $150 depending on the requirements.

Yes. The warranty starts at 1 month after launch — the exact term depends on the project's scope and budget: larger projects come with a longer warranty period. It covers bug fixes in delivered functionality. Beyond that, ongoing technical support and development are available on separate terms: uptime monitoring, security updates, and new features.

faq.q: What tech stack do you use?
faq.a: Frontend: Astro and Next.js built on React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Backend and automation: Node.js and Bun; Python for parsers and scripts; Go for high-load systems. Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, Drizzle ORM, deployed in Docker. We pick the stack for the task, not the other way around.
